prompt: A graph shows the variation with time t of the linear momentum p of an object moving in a straight line. Which feature of the graph represents the resultant force acting on the object?
options: the area between the line and the time axis
the area between the line and the momentum axis
the intercept on the momentum axis

answer.explanation: By Newton's second law, F = Delta p / Delta t, which is the gradient of a momentum-time graph.

distractor_explanations: Option 1 confuses the momentum-time graph with a force-time graph (where area represents impulse).
Option 2 does not represent resultant force.
Option 3 is correct. F = Delta p / Delta t, which equals the gradient of the p-t graph.
Option 4 represents initial momentum at t = 0.
hints: Write the definition of force in terms of momentum: F = Delta p / Delta t.
What mathematical feature of a p against t graph corresponds to Delta p / Delta t?
solution: F = Delta p / Delta t, which corresponds to the gradient of the momentum-time graph. Option C is correct.
teacher_walkthrough: Recall F = Delta p / Delta t.
On a graph of p against t, the rate of change is Delta y / Delta x = gradient.
Contrast with F against t graph, where area under the line gives Delta p.
